requirements.description: Daily prices, split/dividend adjustment factors, shares outstanding, and data currency for primary-issue stocks domiciled in the 13 non-Canada sample countries (AUT, BEL, FIN, FRA, DEU, ITA, JPN, NLD, NOR, ESP, SWE, CHE, GBR), January 1985-June 2006. Monthly total returns are built from month-end-to-month-end adjusted prices (prccd/ajexdi). Coverage verified live: 2,460 firms in 1985 growing to ~9,800 in 2005 (paper's pooled universe averages ~9,500 firm-months/month; 18,117 unique firms total across all years).

Daily prices for Canadian stocks 1985-2006. Compustat Global has essentially no Canadian coverage (loc=CAN primary issues: 0 firms through 1999); Canadian equities live in Compustat North America. Verified live via security.excntry='CAN': 448 firms with prices in 1985, 1,335 in 1995, 3,472 in 2005 (paper reports 2,714 unique Canadian firms total). North-American secd confirmed to carry prccd, ajexdi, cshoc, curcdd.

Country-of-domicile classification for global firms (g_company.loc, ISO3 codes) and exchange-country for the North-American file (security.excntry='CAN'). g_company.prirow identifies each firm's primary issue (iid), used to select one security per firm and avoid double-counting cross-listings. Verified live: all 14 target countries present with plausible firm counts.

Exchange rates to convert local-currency returns and market caps to U.S. dollars (paper measures returns in USD, page 3). g_exrt_dly stores GBP-base cross rates: each row is (fromcurd='GBP', tocurd=X, exratd = units of X per GBP). The USD price of currency X is exratd(GBP->X)/exratd(GBP->USD), so GBP cancels in monthly FX-change ratios. Verified live: GBP->X daily series exist for every currency appearing in the 1985-2006 universe (ATS, BEF, CAD, CHF, DEM, ESP, EUR, FIM, FRF, ITL, JPY, NLG, NOK, SEK, USD, plus minor CZK/EGP/ILS/XEU), all covering 1984-12-03 through 2006-06-30 (~7,768 obs each). EUR series starts 1985-12-31; eurozone securities carry legacy currencies in curcdd until 1999, EUR after.

Market capitalization for value-weighted deciles (Table 3 VW panel) and USD size sorts (Table 5, used in Table 1 diagnostics). Computed as prccd x cshoc in local currency at month-end, converted to USD with the month-end GBP-cross rate. No qunit rescaling: A3 verified cshoc is in actual shares (NTT anchor $211bn at 2000-06-30). cshoc can be stale on some days; the pipeline carries the last non-missing value within each security.

Security-type and status fields to restrict the universe to ordinary common equities (paper is silent on security filters; this is the standard Compustat convention, logged in assumptions). g_security provides tpci and secstat per (gvkey, iid); g_company.costat gives company active/inactive status. Delisted firms remain in both masters, preserving survivorship-free coverage.
